skill_en: Reads 60+ sight words including function words and connectors
skill_hi: 60+ दृष्टि शब्द पढ़ता है जिनमें कार्य शब्द और योजक शामिल हैं
A_what: Hindi tongue twisters for fluency and phonological awareness. Fun competitive format.
B_what: Shows how changing the matra changes the word meaning. Minimal pairs for matra awareness.
notes: Sight words and function words relate heavily to overall fluent reading speed and articulation, which aligns well with fluency exercises like tongue twisters.

skill_en: Reads all types of complex words (double conjuncts, compound words)
skill_hi: सभी प्रकार के जटिल शब्द पढ़ता है (दोहरे संयुक्त, समास)

A_what: Teacher reads a story aloud, pauses at a key moment. All levels engage with prediction and comprehension.
B_what: Hindi tongue twisters for fluency and phonological awareness. Fun competitive format.
notes: Complex words appear naturally in rich read-aloud stories, supporting contextual decoding and comprehension.

skill_en: Reads unfamiliar words using decoding strategies

A_what: Teacher reads a letter aloud. Children respond at their level — from listening comprehension to writing back.
B_title_hi: कहानी का समय: आगे क्या होगा?

skill_en: Extends and creates growing patterns (AB, ABC, ABB, AAB)

A_what: A shared story about buying items at a market. Beginners count items, Progressors add prices, Proficients calculate totals with carry.

notes: Shapes have clear repeating visual patterns.

skill_en: Orders numbers up to 99 (ascending and descending)

B_what: Teacher announces a "secret number" — children decode it using place value clues.
notes: Place value and number sequencing are directly reinforced by decoding numbers from place value clues.
